summary: Ansible assumes SSH keys; use --ask-pass for password logins and --ask-become-pass for sudo passwords. Load keys into ssh-agent, or use --private-key or ansible_ssh_private_key_file.
questions: How do I use a password instead of SSH keys with Ansible?
How do I give Ansible my sudo password?
How do I use a .pem key file with Ansible?
How do I avoid typing my SSH key passphrase every run?

answer_card.title: SSH keys and passwords
answer_card.answer_md:
- Password SSH login: `--ask-pass`
- Privilege escalation password: `--ask-become-pass`
- Avoid retyping key passphrases:
  ```bash
  ssh-agent bash
  ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa    # or ~/.ssh/keypair.pem
  ```
- Or point at a key with `--private-key`, or `ansible_ssh_private_key_file` in inventory.
